course.title: Unit 6 How do you feel?-Part A--【例句】

sentences.content: What’s this cartoon about? It’s about a cat who is a police officer.
sentences.english: What's this cartoon about ? It's about a cat who is a police officer
sentences.chinese: 这部动画片讲的是什么？它讲的是一只当警察的猫的故事。

sentences.content: He chases the mice. They’re afraid of him.
sentences.english: He chases the mice . They're afraid of him
sentences.chinese: 他追赶老鼠。它们都怕他。

wordDetails.definition: chase（第三人称单数）: 追逐

sentences.content: Why? Because the mice are bad. They hurt people. The cat is angry with them.
sentences.english: Why ? Because the mice are bad . They hurt people . The cat is angry with them
sentences.chinese: 为什么？因为老鼠很坏。它们伤害人类。猫对它们很生气。

sentences.content: How do you feel when you see the mice? I feel angry.
sentences.english: How do you feel when you see the mice ? I feel angry
sentences.chinese: 当你看到老鼠时，你感觉如何？我感到愤怒。

sentences.content: She is sad because she can’t go to the zoo.
sentences.english: She is sad because she can't go to the zoo
sentences.chinese: 她很难过，因为她不能去动物园。

sentences.content: He is happy because he got a new toy.
sentences.english: He is happy because he got a new toy
sentences.chinese: 他很开心，因为他得到了一个新玩具。

sentences.content: They are worried about the exam.
sentences.english: They are worried about the exam

wordDetails.definition: are（现在时复数）: 构成现在进行时

sentences.content: I feel afraid when I see a big dog.
sentences.english: I feel afraid when I see a big dog
sentences.chinese: 我看到大狗时会感到害怕。

sentences.content: Are you happy today? Yes, I am. I’m going to see my friends.
sentences.english: Are you happy today ? Yes , I am . I'm going to see my friends
sentences.chinese: 你今天开心吗？是的，我很开心。我要去见我的朋友了。

wordDetails.definition: are（现在时）: 构成疑问句
am（现在时）: 构成现在时

sentences.content: The cat is ill. Sarah feels worried.
sentences.english: The cat is ill . Sarah feels worried
